original: Given `NaxConfigSchema.parse({})`, when the config is parsed, then `config.autoPr.enabled === false`.
refined: Assert that `NaxConfigSchema.parse({}).autoPr.enabled` is `false` (boolean literal).

original: Given `NaxConfigSchema.parse({})`, when the config is parsed, then `config.autoPr.draft === true`.
refined: Assert that `NaxConfigSchema.parse({}).autoPr.draft` is `true` (boolean literal).

original: Given `NaxConfigSchema.parse({ autoPr: { enabled: true } })`, when the config is parsed, then `autoPr.enabled === true` and `autoPr.draft === true`.
refined: Assert that `NaxConfigSchema.parse({ autoPr: { enabled: true } }).autoPr.enabled` is `true` AND `.autoPr.draft` is `true` (both boolean literals).

original: Given `NaxConfigSchema.safeParse({ autoPr: { enabled: "yes" } })`, when the config is parsed, then `success === false`.
refined: Assert that `NaxConfigSchema.safeParse({ autoPr: { enabled: 'yes' } }).success` is `false` (boolean literal), indicating invalid type for `enabled` field.

original: Given a context whose `feature` is `"auto-pr-plugin"`, when `buildTitle` is called, then it returns `"feat: auto-pr-plugin"`.
refined: Assert that `buildTitle({ feature: 'auto-pr-plugin', stories: [], cost: 0, duration: 0, prdPath: '' })` returns the string `"feat: auto-pr-plugin"` exactly.

original: Given `buildBody(ctx, null)`, when the body is generated, then the result includes a review-pending banner referencing `nax-finish`.
refined: Assert that the string returned by `buildBody(ctx, null)` contains the substring `"Auto-opened by nax — review pending. Run nax-finish before merge."`.

original: Given `buildBody(ctx, null)`, when the body is generated, then the story table has exactly `ctx.stories.length` rows.
refined: Assert that when `buildBody({ ...ctx, stories: [...] }, null)` is called, the returned string contains exactly `ctx.stories.length + 1` pipe-separated cells in the story table header and data rows combined (excluding the header separator row `|-------|...`). Each data row matches pattern `| US-XXX | ... | .. |`.

original: Given `buildBody(ctx, null)` and `storySummary` of `{ completed: 3, failed: 0, skipped: 1, paused: 0 }`, when the body is generated, then the result reports `3 passed` and `1 skipped`.
refined: Assert that `buildBody({ ...ctx, stories: [], storySummary: { completed: 3, failed: 0, skipped: 1, paused: 0 } }, null)` returns a string containing both `"3 passed"` and `"1 skipped"` as substrings in the run summary line.

original: Given `buildBody(ctx, "## Checklist\n- [ ] x")`, when the body is generated, then the result ends with the template text verbatim and includes a preceding `---` separator.
refined:
Assert that `buildBody(ctx, "## Checklist
- [ ] x")` returns a string that (1) ends with `"## Checklist
- [ ] x"` exactly, and (2) contains `"---

## Checklist"` somewhere in the string before the end.

original: Given `buildBody(ctx, null)`, when the body is generated, then the result contains no `---` template separator.
refined: Assert that `buildBody(ctx, null)` returns a string that does not contain the substring `"---"` anywhere.

original: Given `findPrTemplate(workdir, "github", deps)` where `deps.readText` resolves `.github/pull_request_template.md`, when the template is looked up, then the function returns that file's contents.
refined: Assert that `findPrTemplate('/wd', 'github', { readText: async (p) => p === '.github/pull_request_template.md' ? 'template content' : null, run: noop })` returns `'template content'` when `deps.readText('.github/pull_request_template.md')` resolves to `'template content'` and all other paths resolve to `null`.

original: Given `findPrTemplate(workdir, "github", deps)` where both `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` and `docs/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` resolve, when the template is looked up, then the function returns the `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` contents.
refined: Assert that `findPrTemplate('/wd', 'github', { readText: async (p) => p === '.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md' ? 'github content' : p === 'docs/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md' ? 'docs content' : null, run: noop })` returns `'github content'` (not `'docs content'`), verifying the `.github/` path takes precedence over `docs/`.

original: Given `findPrTemplate(workdir, "gitlab", deps)` where `deps.readText` resolves `.gitlab/merge_request_templates/Default.md`, when the template is looked up, then the function returns that file's contents.
refined: Assert that `findPrTemplate('/wd', 'gitlab', { readText: async (p) => p === '.gitlab/merge_request_templates/Default.md' ? 'gitlab default content' : null, run: noop })` returns `'gitlab default content'`.

original: Given `findPrTemplate(workdir, "github", deps)` where no template path resolves, when the template is looked up, then the function returns `null`.
refined: Assert that `findPrTemplate('/wd', 'github', { readText: async () => null, run: noop })` returns `null` (all checked paths return `null`).

original: Given `detectForge("git@github.com:owner/repo.git")`, when the forge is detected, then the function returns `"github"`.
refined: Calling `detectForge("git@github.com:owner/repo.git")` returns the string value `"github"` (type `ForgeKind.GITHUB`). The return value is a non-null string matching the literal `ForgeKind.GITHUB`.

original: Given `detectForge("https://gitlab.com/owner/repo.git")`, when the forge is detected, then the function returns `"gitlab"`.
refined: Calling `detectForge("https://gitlab.com/owner/repo.git")` returns the string value `"gitlab"` (type `ForgeKind.GITLAB`). The return value is a non-null string matching the literal `ForgeKind.GITLAB`.

original: Given `detectForge("https://example.com/owner/repo.git")`, when the forge is detected, then the function returns `null`.
refined: Calling `detectForge("https://example.com/owner/repo.git")` returns `null`. The return type is `ForgeKind | null` and the actual value is the JavaScript `null` literal.

original: Given `openDraft` for a GitHub forge with `draft: true`, when the runner is invoked, then the argv begins with `["gh", "pr", "create", "--draft", ...]` and includes the branch via `--head`.
refined: When `openDraft({ forge: "github", branch: "my-branch", draft: true, title: "...", body: "...", cwd: "/tmp" })` is called, `_deps.run` is invoked with an `argv` array where: (1) `argv[0] === "gh"`, `argv[1] === "pr"`, `argv[2] === "create"`, `argv[3] === "--draft"`, and (2) argv contains an element matching the regex pattern `--head=my-branch`.

original: Given `openDraft` for a GitLab forge with `draft: true`, when the runner is invoked, then the argv begins with `["glab", "mr", "create", "--draft", ...]` and includes the branch via `--source-branch`.
refined: When `openDraft({ forge: "gitlab", branch: "my-branch", draft: true, title: "...", body: "...", cwd: "/tmp" })` is called, `_deps.run` is invoked with an `argv` array where: (1) `argv[0] === "glab"`, `argv[1] === "mr"`, `argv[2] === "create"`, `argv[3] === "--draft"`, and (2) argv contains an element matching the regex pattern `--source-branch=my-branch`.

original: Given `openDraft` with `draft: false`, when the runner is invoked, then the argv omits `--draft`.
refined: When `openDraft({ forge: "github", branch: "my-branch", draft: false, title: "...", body: "...", cwd: "/tmp" })` is called, the `argv` array passed to `_deps.run` contains no element equal to the string `"--draft"`.

original: Given `openDraft` where the runner returns `exitCode: 0`, when stdout contains the created PR URL, then the returned result carries that URL.
refined: When `_deps.run` resolves to `{ exitCode: 0, stdout: "https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123\n", stderr: "" }`, the returned `Promise<OpenDraftResult>` resolves to an object where `success === true` and `url === "https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123"`.

original: Given `openDraft` where the runner returns a non-zero `exitCode`, when the result is returned, then `success === false`.
refined: When `_deps.run` resolves to `{ exitCode: 1, stdout: "", stderr: "error message" }`, the returned `Promise<OpenDraftResult>` resolves to an object where `success === false`.

original: Given `hasOpenPr` where the injected list runner returns a non-empty JSON array for the branch, when the open PR state is checked, then the function returns `true`.
refined: When `_deps.run` resolves to `{ exitCode: 0, stdout: "[{\"number\": 42}]", stderr: "" }` for the branch query, `hasOpenPr({ forge: "github", branch: "my-branch", cwd: "/tmp" })` returns `Promise<boolean>` resolving to `true`.

original: Given `hasOpenPr` where the injected list runner returns an empty JSON array for the branch, when the open PR state is checked, then the function returns `false`.
refined: When `_deps.run` resolves to `{ exitCode: 0, stdout: "[]", stderr: "" }` for the branch query, `hasOpenPr({ forge: "github", branch: "my-branch", cwd: "/tmp" })` returns `Promise<boolean>` resolving to `false`.

original: Given `ctx.config.autoPr.enabled === false`, when `autoPrPlugin.shouldRun` is called, then it returns `false`.
refined: When `autoPrPlugin.shouldRun({ ...defaultCtx, config: { autoPr: { enabled: false } } })` is invoked, the return value is `false`.

original: Given `ctx.storySummary.failed > 0`, when `shouldRun` is called, then it returns `false`.
refined: When `autoPrPlugin.shouldRun({ ...defaultCtx, storySummary: { failed: 1, completed: 5, skipped: 0, paused: 0 } })` is invoked, the return value is `false`.

original: Given `ctx.storySummary.paused > 0`, when `shouldRun` is called, then it returns `false`.
refined: When `autoPrPlugin.shouldRun({ ...defaultCtx, storySummary: { failed: 0, completed: 5, skipped: 0, paused: 1 } })` is invoked, the return value is `false`.

original: Given `ctx.storySummary.completed === 0`, when `shouldRun` is called, then it returns `false`.
refined: When `autoPrPlugin.shouldRun({ ...defaultCtx, storySummary: { failed: 0, completed: 0, skipped: 0, paused: 0 } })` is invoked, the return value is `false`.

original: Given a remote whose host resolves to no forge, when `shouldRun` is called and `detectForge` returns `null`, then it returns `false`.
refined: When `detectForge` is stubbed to return `null` and `autoPrPlugin.shouldRun(defaultCtx)` is invoked, the return value is `false`.

original: Given `hasOpenPr` reports an existing open PR for the branch, when `shouldRun` is called, then it returns `false` and logs the skip reason.
refined: When `hasOpenPr` is stubbed to return `true` and `autoPrPlugin.shouldRun(defaultCtx)` is invoked, the return value is `false` and `ctx.logger.warn` was called with a string containing `"already open"` or `"skip"`.

original: Given the plugin is enabled, every story passed, a forge is detected, and no open PR exists, when `shouldRun` is called, then it returns `true`.
refined: When `autoPrPlugin.shouldRun({ ...defaultCtx, config: { autoPr: { enabled: true } }, storySummary: { failed: 0, completed: 3, skipped: 0, paused: 0 }, detectForge: stubForge, hasOpenPr: stubFalse })` is invoked, the return value is `true`.

original: Given the happy path, when `execute` is called, then it invokes `openDraft` with the `buildTitle` title and `buildBody` body and returns a `PostRunActionResult` with `success === true` and the created PR `url`.
refined: When `openDraft` is stubbed to return `{ url: "https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123" }` and `autoPrPlugin.execute(defaultCtx)` is invoked, `openDraft` was called with `(branch, { title: <string>, body: <string> }, expect.any(Function))` and the returned `PostRunActionResult` has `success: true` and `url: "https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123"`.

original: Given `openDraft` reports a non-zero forge failure, when `execute` is called, then it returns `{ success: false }` and does not throw.
refined: When `openDraft` is stubbed to return `{ success: false, message: "forge exited with 1" }` and `autoPrPlugin.execute(defaultCtx)` is invoked, the returned value is `{ success: false, message: "forge exited with 1" }` and no exception is thrown.

original: Given the forge CLI is unavailable and `openDraft` throws, when `execute` is called, then it returns `{ success: false }`, records the failure through `ctx.logger.warn`, and makes no `console.*` call.
refined: When `openDraft` is stubbed to throw `new Error("ENOENT: gh not found")` and `autoPrPlugin.execute(defaultCtx)` is invoked, the returned value is `{ success: false }`, `ctx.logger.warn` was called exactly once, and `console.warn`, `console.error`, and `console.log` were not called.

original: Given `loadPlugins` runs with `"nax-auto-pr"` not present in the disabled set, when `getPostRunActions()` is read from the returned `PluginRegistry`, then it includes an action named `"nax-auto-pr"`.
refined: When `loadPlugins({ disabled: [] })` is called and the returned registry's `getPostRunActions()` is invoked, the resulting array contains an action object with `name: "nax-auto-pr"`.
